svg.title: Splice graph decomposition for sample SRR36710387 and gene ENSG00000196924.21
svg.desc: Three aligned directed splice graphs show the observed normalized signal, gradient component, and cycle component. Every panel uses the same nodes, edges, direction, edge IDs, and line-width scale.
svg.text: Nodes: 32 · Junctions: 22 · Cycle fraction: 0.0854 · Mathematical checks: PASS
Same graph layout and edge IDs in every panel. Line width uses one shared absolute-value scale.
Arrows always retain the stored biological junction direction.
Junction values (same edge order in every panel)
Node key (plot IDs, not transcript exon numbers)
Observed signal = gradient component + cycle component. Signs are relative to the stored edge direction.
Cycle-space structure alone does not establish circular RNA or disease causation.
